list_domains.label: List All Domains
list_domains.description: Retrieve a list of all domains in your account.

per_page.label: Results Per Page
per_page.description: Number of domains to return per page (1-200).

page.label: Page
page.description: Which page of results to return.

create_domain.label: Create Domain
create_domain.description: Add a new domain to your DigitalOcean account.

ip_address.label: IP Address
ip_address.description: Optional IP address to create an A record pointing to the apex domain.

get_domain.label: Get Domain
get_domain.description: Retrieve details about a specific domain.

domain_name.label: Domain Name
domain_name.description: The domain name to retrieve (e.g., example.com).

list_droplets.label: List All Droplets
list_droplets.description: Retrieve a list of all Droplets in your account.

per_page.label: Results Per Page
per_page.description: Number of Droplets to return per page (1-200).

page.label: Page
page.description: Which page of results to return.

tag_name.label: Tag Name
tag_name.description: Filter Droplets by a specific tag. Cannot be combined with Name or Type.

name.label: Name
name.description: Filter by exact Droplet name (case-insensitive). Cannot be combined with Tag Name.

type.label: Type
type.description: Filter by Droplet type. Cannot be combined with Tag Name.

get_droplet.label: Get Droplet
get_droplet.description: Retrieve details about a specific Droplet.

list_database_clusters.label: List Database Clusters
list_database_clusters.description: Retrieve a list of all database clusters in your account.

tag_name.label: Tag Name
tag_name.description: Filter database clusters by a specific tag.

list_database_events.label: List Database Events
list_database_events.description: Retrieve all event logs for a database cluster.
